categories.main_business_segments: Jinko Solar Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the photovoltaic (PV) industry, focusing on the research, development, production, and sales of solar photovoltaic components, solar cells, and silicon wafers. The company has established a vertically integrated production capacity covering silicon wafer manufacturing, solar cell production, and PV module assembly. Additionally, it is expanding into energy storage systems and integrated solar-storage solutions.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leads in N-type TOPCon solar cell technology, achieving high conversion efficiencies (over 26.7% in mass production and 34.22% in lab for tandem cells). It employs advanced manufacturing methods including large-size silicon wafers, multi-busbar cells, half-cut cells, and bifacial modules with transparent backsheet technology. Digitalization and intelligent manufacturing, including AI, cloud computing, and IoT, are integrated into production to enhance efficiency and quality.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Jinko Solar serves global photovoltaic power plant investors, developers, contractors, and distributors of distributed PV systems. Its products cater to large-scale utility projects and residential/commercial distributed generation markets. The company has a diversified customer base across nearly 200 countries and regions, with significant sales in China, Europe, the Americas, Asia-Pacific, and emerging markets such as the Middle East and Southeast Asia.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with manufacturing bases and sales networks in China, the United States, Vietnam, Malaysia, Saudi Arabia, and other countries. It has established production facilities in key markets including the US and Middle East, and sales offices covering major regions such as China, Europe, Americas, Asia-Pacific, and emerging markets like Southeast Asia and the Middle East.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jinko Solar operates as a vertically integrated manufacturer covering upstream (silicon wafer production), midstream (solar cell manufacturing), and downstream (PV module assembly and sales) segments of the photovoltaic supply chain. It also engages in energy storage system production, positioning itself as a comprehensive clean energy solutions provider.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation with a focus on advancing N-type TOPCon cell technology, tandem perovskite cells, and high-efficiency PV modules. It invests heavily in R&D to improve conversion efficiency, reduce costs, and develop differentiated products for extreme environments. Digital transformation and intelligent manufacturing are strategic pillars, alongside expanding energy storage and integrated solar-storage solutions to support global energy transition.
categories.revenue_model: Jinko Solar generates revenue primarily through the sale of photovoltaic products including silicon wafers, solar cells, and PV modules. It also earns income from energy storage system sales and related technical services. The company’s revenue is derived from direct sales to global PV project developers, distributors, and end customers, with a mix of direct and distribution sales channels.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Jinko Solar is a global leader in the photovoltaic industry, ranking first in global PV module shipments for six consecutive years. It competes with other major PV manufacturers such as Trina Solar, LONGi Green Energy, and Canadian Solar. The company maintains a strong market position through technological leadership, vertical integration, global manufacturing footprint, and diversified market presence.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Jinko Solar reported revenues of approximately RMB 92.47 billion, a 22.08% decrease from the previous year, primarily due to intensified market competition and declining PV product prices. Net profit attributable to shareholders dropped sharply by 98.67% to RMB 98.9 million. Despite short-term challenges, the company achieved a global module shipment of 92.87 GW, an 18.28% increase, demonstrating strong operational scale and market demand.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Jinko Solar emphasizes high-efficiency, high-power PV products based on advanced N-type TOPCon technology, offering superior conversion efficiency and reliability. Its differentiated product portfolio includes high-performance bifacial modules with enhanced durability for extreme environments. The company’s vertically integrated supply chain, global manufacturing capabilities, and digitalized production processes enable cost leadership and consistent quality, delivering greater value and lower levelized cost of electricity to customers.
